children: Maheshwari joins Classplus after leading finance at Zupee, bringing more than 13 years of experience across technology, auto e-commerce, capital strategy and business finance

Classplus has appointed Ankit Maheshwari as Chief Financial Officer (CFO), with the finance executive moving from Zupee, where he served as Head of Finance. Maheshwari brings more than 13 years of experience across technology, entertainment tech and auto e-commerce, with his work spanning fundraising, financial planning, capital strategy, governance, controls and business transformation.

Maheshwari joins Classplus after serving as Head of Finance at Zupee. His responsibilities there included supporting the company’s finance function across planning, controls, capital management and business decision-making.
The appointment marks his move into a CFO role after holding senior finance positions across businesses operating in fast-growing technology-led sectors.
At Classplus, his mandate is expected to cover financial controls, business insights, capital allocation and strengthening the role of finance in supporting wider business decisions.
Before Zupee, Maheshwari served as Head of Finance and Vice President at Cars24.

His responsibilities at the company covered investor relations, treasury, financial planning and analysis, business finance, controllership, taxation, risk, governance, supply chain finance and finance transformation.
He was also involved in financial efficiency, unit economics and regulatory compliance while overseeing finance responsibilities across several operational and strategic areas.
Across his career, Maheshwari has worked on project financing, equity and debt fundraising, financial modelling, capital strategy, governance and business transformation.
His experience also includes building finance processes, strengthening controls and supporting businesses through periods of expansion and operational change.
Earlier in his career, he worked with Den Networks and IBM, where he gained experience across financial analysis and operational finance.
